boundary: Packaged hosted editor / isolated Linux project / native Chromium input events
browserPath: Browser plugin not available; retained Playwright

checks.name: real focused native control has bounded accessible role/name
real Chromium composition pipeline commits Korean text exactly once
native clipboard paste preserves accents, emoji and RTL Unicode
explicit copy returns selected plain text through the current fenced generation
F6 leaves the raster keyboard focus trap
input and clipboard do not change accepted source/history
hard bounded expiry and fresh reconnect preserve canonical source/history
expired generation text is never replayed into a new runtime
native key pressure reaches bounded queue and reconnect discards all queued old-generation events
fresh generation receives no stale queued text or canonical mutation

compositionLimit: Chromium CDP uses trusted composition start/update/input events but its commit compositionend is untrusted; OS input-method validation is not claimed.
